hook: Regain Your Confidence And Take Control Of Your Life!
claim: Fluxactive Complete is a prostate and bladder supplement with a proprietary formula of 14 'prostate and bladder antioxidants, minerals, vitamins and herbs'.
ing_note: The page names these ingredients among the 14 in the blend; amounts are not given.
refund_note: The refund policy requires returning the product within 60 days of receiving it.
checks: Saw palmetto worked no better than placebo for urinary symptoms in the largest trials.
The claim that damiana works better 'combined with saw palmetto' isn't supported by any clinical study.
Ginkgo is described as promoting 'normal functioning of the urethra', which isn't based on research.
Many ingredients (damiana, epimedium, muira puama, ginseng) are libido herbs rather than prostate ingredients.
cons: Weak evidence for every key ingredient
Mix of libido herbs sold as prostate support
verdict: Fluxactive Complete combines a failed prostate herb (saw palmetto) with libido herbs and vitamins. It's unlikely to help urinary symptoms meaningfully. See a doctor about frequent or urgent urination: prescription BPH medicines work, and checking PSA helps rule out more serious problems.
